inspect-security.title: Inspect the station
inspect-security.prompt: Mark each item safe or a hazard.

config.scene: You're checking a friend's home station and car.

items.label: The station's main power goes through a key-operated switch.
items.why: No one can switch the station on without the key.

items.label: The microphone stays in the parked car.
items.why: Anyone could get in and transmit. Take the microphone with you.

items.label: A wrench is resting across the car battery terminals.
items.why: The battery's short-circuit current can make the wrench red-hot.

items.label: The high-voltage supply has an interlock switch on its cabinet.
items.why: Opening the cabinet cuts the power before anyone can touch the high voltage.

items.label: Someone is probing a power supply that's plugged in with its cover off.
items.why: Working on a live supply risks a fatal shock. Unplug it first.

items.label: A faulty supply is switched off and unplugged before it's opened.
items.why: That's exactly the right first step.
